subject.title: feat(channels): batch 1 producers drop media placeholder bodies

question: Should `formatMediaPlaceholderText` remain a supported public `channel-inbound` plugin SDK API, or should the text-only-carrier formatting stay private until a broader channel contract is approved?
rationale: This is a new public plugin API rather than a purely internal cleanup, and repository policy treats plugin SDK additions as compatibility-sensitive contract decisions.

options.title: Approve the public formatter contract
options.body: Keep the documented formatter and type export, with focused compatibility tests and real channel proof before merge.

options.title: Keep formatting private for now
options.body: Use an owner-local or internal helper for the current Mattermost carrier and defer a public SDK API until more consumers establish the common contract.

recommendation.title: Approve the public formatter contract
recommendation.body: Keep the documented formatter and type export, with focused compatibility tests and real channel proof before merge.

likelyOwner.reason: The related merged structured-media work and this branch both connect steipete to the proposed channel-media contract.
